summary.en: Eri invites Ran and Conan to dinner along with her friend Yuko Arisawa. Yuko tells Eri that someone is stalking her husband and wants her to help. Her husband, Shiro Arisawa, calls her and reveals he is currently attending a wake and will be home in two hours. While eating at a hotel restaurant, Yuko tells them she strongly admires Hajime Kajimoto, her former judo senpai and the current coach of Japan's judo team. After dinner, Yuko takes them all to her house and there, they find Shiro strangled with his necktie. Yuko's strange behavior causes both Conan and Eri to suspect her for murdering her husband, but they are unable to disprove her alibi.
